sources.title: 49ers player gets cut after flying 16 hours to Australia: Why he might be sent home and why they made the move
sources.description: San Francisco made room for long snapper Jon Weeks ahead of the opener in Melbourne, a move that could signal George Kittle is ready to return from an Achilles tear.
